passive.name: Flurry
passive.text: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

spells.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
spells.text: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

spells.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
spells.text: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

spells.name: Tempest / Cripple
spells.text: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

spells.name: Dragon's Rage
spells.text: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

damage.value: Lee Sin deals burst physical damage with Q and R and burst magic damage with E.

archetype.value: Lee Sin is a jungle skirmisher playmaker who thrives on mechanical outplays.

axis.value: Lee Sin can take short trades around his two empowered basic attacks after an ability.

winCondition.value: Lee Sin controls vision with Safeguard ward-hops and uses Dragon’s Rage to finish skirmishes.

spikes.why: Lee Sin can use Sonic Wave more often as its cooldown falls to 6 seconds.

mistakes.value: Lee Sin loses Resonating Strike if he does not recast Q within 3 seconds of a Sonic Wave hit.
